newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK two-year notes average accepted yield 5.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK two-year notes average accepted yield 5.78 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of two-year 5.72 percent Exchange Fund notes at Monday's tender was 5.78 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with an average accepted yield of 6.12 percent and a coupon of 6.00 percent at the last tender on August 12.
Bids for Monday's HK$500 million issue totalled HK$2.6 billion against HK$4.71 billion at the previous tender.
The notes mature on November 12, 1998, the HKMA said.
